mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a month and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by less than 0.2% in the same period, it indicates strong demand without significant inflationary pressure, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the same period, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% in a month and GDP (GDPC1) also shows a decline, it indicates a contraction in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month and GDPC1 decreases
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
